note: Ground truth for the groundedness judge calibration set. Each variant is the genuine report with specific claims altered. The judge should flag every 'planted_claims' entry as unsupported/contradicted and should NOT flag anything else as unsupported (false-positive check) when run against the genuine baseline. 'match_keyword' is a distinctive substring (case-insensitive) expected to appear in whatever paraphrase the judge extracts for this claim -- used by run_groundedness_experiment.py to match judge output back to planted claims without exact-string matching.

variants.description: Real, sourced numbers replaced with different plausible-looking numbers that contradict the raw source content.

planted_claims.contradicts_source: airport transfer web_research answer: 'Urgench to Khiva: $30 economy ($35 SUV, $40 minivan) — 33 km, ~30 minutes'

planted_claims.claim: Pre-booked private transfer costs $45 economy car, $55 SUV
planted_claims.contradicts_source: airport transfer web_research answer: 'Urgench to Khiva: $30 economy ($35 SUV, $40 minivan)'

planted_claims.claim: Terrassa Café & Restaurant is open until 2am daily
planted_claims.contradicts_source: report's own earlier synthesis of venue hours (11:30pm); 2am is not attested anywhere in web_research sources

planted_claims.claim: Beeline Tourist Start package costs $12 for 5GB + 7 days
planted_claims.contradicts_source: eSIM/SIM web_research answer describing the $3 / 15GB / 15-day Beeline Tourist Start package

variants.description: Specific, confident-sounding claims added that appear nowhere in any web_research source and are not inferable from them.

planted_claims.claim: A special night bus service runs between Itchan Kala and the new town every 30 minutes until 1am on Fridays and Saturdays
planted_claims.contradicts_source: directly contradicts the sourced claim in the same report that buses stop at 10pm and that late-night transport is 'a genuine gap in Khiva'; no source mentions any night bus

planted_claims.claim: In a 2026 survey, 94% of solo female travelers rated Khiva specifically as 'very safe,' the highest of any city in the country
planted_claims.contradicts_source: no survey or statistic appears in any web_research source for the safety questions; fabricated precise figure

planted_claims.claim: Khiva Sky Lounge — rooftop bar with a resident DJ, open until 1:30am on weekends, the closest thing to a club inside the old city walls
planted_claims.contradicts_source: no such venue appears in any web_research source; directly contradicts the sourced claim that 'there is no club scene, no DJ nights, no techno' in Khiva

planted_claims.claim: Ucell offers a tourist eSIM with unlimited data for $8/week that runs noticeably faster than Beeline in Khiva
planted_claims.contradicts_source: eSIM web_research source states all eSIM providers (Airalo, Jetpac, Esimy) run on Beeline's network, the weakest carrier; no Ucell eSIM or speed comparison appears in any source

variants.description: Real sourced claims flipped to their opposite.

planted_claims.claim: Uber and Bolt both operate widely here alongside Yandex Go
planted_claims.original: Uber and Bolt do not operate here
planted_claims.contradicts_source: ride-hailing web_research answer: 'Uber... Does not work in Uzbekistan... Bolt: Available in Aze[rbaijan]...' (i.e. neither operates in Uzbekistan)

planted_claims.claim: Khiva has a small but lively club scene alongside its cultural venues
planted_claims.original: There is no club scene, no DJ nights, no techno (in Khiva)
planted_claims.contradicts_source: nightlife web_research synthesis explicitly states no club scene/DJ nights/techno in Khiva, that Tashkent is where the club scene is

planted_claims.claim: CMI Bar is open every night of the week
planted_claims.contradicts_source: 'best nights' web_research answer: 'CMI Bar is only open these nights' (Thursday, Friday, Saturday)

planted_claims.claim: Card acceptance is excellent and widely accepted everywhere in Khiva, including small vendors and market stalls
planted_claims.original: Card acceptance is inconsistent outside larger hotels
planted_claims.contradicts_source: no source claims widespread card acceptance; original report's own payment guidance says the opposite and recommends carrying cash
